ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: Day 19 of the cycle, trend intact above a rising 10-day average, weekly still mixed.
ladder.next: Hold; first warning would be losing the 10-day average, bigger warning is a daily momentum cross down.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum positive; 3-day crossed up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 30 · failed · daily cycle day 19).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: Trend intact — hold; add on dips toward the 10-day average.
entry.text_zh: 趋势完好——持有；可在回调至 10 日均线附近时加仓。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 19 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 19 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 30 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 30 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked mid-way — a neutral, balanced structure.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在中段见顶——结构中性、均衡。

ladder.why_zh: 周期第 19 天，趋势完好并位于向上的 10 日均线之上，周线仍为混合。
ladder.next_zh: 持有；首个预警是失守 10 日均线，更大的预警是日线动量向下交叉。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为正；3 日线向上交叉；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；投资者周期已逾期（投资者周期第 30 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 19 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal just triggered today (fresh cross from NEARING A LOW). Signal strength: moderate (score +55/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自接近低点翻转）。 信号强度：中等（评分 +55/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入形态（+16）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Flowers Foods, Inc., headquartered in Thomasville, Georgia, is a producer and marketer of packaged bakery foods in the United States. The company operates 44 bakeries across 19 states that produce a variety of products, including bread, buns, snack cakes, rolls, tortillas and pastries.
profile.description_zh: Flowers Foods, Inc. 总部位于佐治亚州托马斯维尔，是美国包装烘焙食品的生产商和销售商。该公司在19个州运营44家面包厂，生产面包、小圆面包、零食蛋糕、卷饼、玉米饼和糕点等多种产品。

accounting_quality.headline: Warning

reads.label: Working capital
reads.detail: inventory +61% vs sales +20% — inventory building, demand risk
reads.detail_zh: 存货 +61% 对销售 +20%——存货积压，需求风险

accounting_quality.basis_zh: 多年趋势 + 同业排名
accounting_quality.caveat: Annual filings, lagged to the report date; free XBRL is sparse for some filers. Context, not a signal — it does not change the technical call.
accounting_quality.caveat_zh: 年度财报，滞后于披露日；免费 XBRL 数据对部分公司不全。仅供参考，并非交易信号，不改变技术面判断。

trust_tier.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust_tier.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

selection.kind_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

headline.en: Long-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime → rate headwind.
headline.zh: 长久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境→利率逆风。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.30 ± 0.21 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLP) reads long-duration (+0.15). Inflation hedge.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.30 ± 0.21——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLP）为长久期（+0.15）。 通胀对冲。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
